mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_ai_knowledge_mastery (student_user_id, knowledge_code, topic, attempt_count, total_score, total_max_score, latest_score_percent, last_practiced_time) VALUES (#{studentUserId}, #{knowledgeCode}, #{topic}, 1, #{score}, #{maxScore}, #{scorePercent}, #{practicedTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE topic = #{topic}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, total_score = total_score + #{score}, total_max_score = total_max_score + #{maxScore}, latest_score_percent = #{scorePercent}, last_practiced_time = #{practicedTime}
